candidate_relations.label: Complete Right Bundle-Branch Block
candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis is Ostium secundum ASD, a structural cardiac defect confirmed by echocardiography (21-mm defect, left-to-right shunt, dilated RA/RV) and catheterization (step-up in O2 saturation at RA level). Complete right bundle-branch block is an electrocardiographic manifestation/consequence of the right ventricular volume overload caused by the ASD, not the final diagnostic entity requested.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: CRBBB is an ECG finding/manifestation commonly associated with OS-ASD due to right heart volume overload, not the primary structural diagnosis
